interpretation: All tested q-ary residue worlds have identical complete families of (n-1)-coordinate projections while remaining pairwise disjoint globally. The natural join of those proper projections is the full q^n cube, a factor-q enlargement over any true residue world. Therefore no deterministic or randomized exact compiler receiving only those local projections can identify the global residue world without extra information; at least log2(q) bits of world identity are information-theoretically necessary, or ceil(log2(q)) fixed binary bits.
